scores.description: separate scores: local, maps, backlinks, geo, lighthouse_agentic ("X/N"), agent_ux, performance, content_quality

check.description: audit_site check id when this restates a core finding (canonical_broken, h1_multiple, link_broken, ...); its count and URLs must equal audit_site's

tool.description: the tool that produced the numbers, e.g. audit_site, seo_check:pagespeed_check.py, index_status

where.description: where to make it, e.g. Rank Math → Titles & Meta → Pages

code.description: Shown verbatim in a grey box (schema, redirect rules, robots.txt, title templates)

paste.description: Green box: prose the agency pastes as-is (a paragraph for the end of blog posts, an FAQ answer). Mark links as __linked words__ [→ /path/].

blocks.description: optional tables / code / paste boxes for the fix

hold.description: waiting for the hotel (e.g. 'waiting for hotel confirmation'): never executed

items.description: One machine-checkable condition that is true once the item is done. recheck_list runs them against the live site. url: a path like "/dining/" or "sitewide" (every page of the recheck crawl) for text_absent / link_absent.

expected.description: Passes only if it is the single H1

oneOf.description: Passes when a page of the site (recheck crawl, else the homepage) links to url
Passes when url is at most expected clicks from source
Passes when the hreflang set is valid, lists the page, has every language (and x-default if asked), and each target answers 200, is indexable, self-canonical and links back
Passes when og:title and og:image are set and the image answers 200
Passes when no heading level is skipped / no heading is empty (header, footer and nav left out)
Passes when generic anchors ("Read more", "Click here") are at most this share of in-content internal links (or fewer than 3)
Passes when source redirects, is gone, or is canonical to url

image.description: Substring of the image src (file name)

href.description: Substring of the href, e.g. the booking-engine link added to a blog post

image.description: substring of the image src (file name)

items.description: One change /hotel-seo execute can make through the site's MCP (or Chrome). URLs are full URLs or paths on the hotel's site; execute resolves them to post ids.

fields.description: Rank Math fields: title, description, focus_keyword, canonical_url, robots, facebook_title, facebook_description, twitter_title, twitter_description

find.description: current visible text of the element (heading, text, button)

template.description: true when the element lives in a shared template (header, footer, loop): group-wide

code.description: the JSON-LD: either the object or the full <script type="application/ld+json">...</script> block; nothing else (execute checks and wraps it)

oneOf.description: Only for a page NOT built with Elementor (its text is not in post content): on an Elementor page use elementor_text or text_replace. Never JSON-LD.

find.description: the exact text on the page now (a phrase, a heading, a button label); for a phone number any format

replace.description: the new text, exactly as it should read

match_mode.description: phone: the same number in every format and tel: link

sitewide.description: true: every page of this hotel (and the header / footer templates), not just url

oneOf.description: Change a phrase wherever it is stored: page text, Elementor widgets, header / footer / global templates, Custom Code, menus (find-text / replace-text). Never JSON-LD.

page_id.description: id of the Build Plan page spec

oneOf.description: A Google Business Profile fix. Execute plans it as its own 'business-profile' batch: one gbp_propose change per action (preview with before -> after and a change id), sent only after the user approves that batch. Never name, address or primary category.

value.description: as gbp_propose takes it: description / website / phone a string (website: the hotel's page; execute adds the team UTM tags); regular_hours [{day, open, close}]; special_hours [{date, closed} | {date, open, close}]; additional_categories [names]; attributes {attribute_id: value, or null to unset}
